title_en: MUNICIPALITY OF PARIS, APARTMENT FOR SALE 1+1 €165,000
description_en: An apartment with a total area of ​​68 m² gross and 58 m² net is offered for sale, located on the second technical floor (first residential) of a well-managed building in the Paris Municipality area, one of the most sought after and developed in Tirana. Internal organization: Living room together with the kitchen area, 1 bedroom; 1 toilet with a window, which provides natural lighting and ventilation; 1 spacious balcony with access from the living room.
